runs.run_id: 14. 建立同源 PBT smoke/correctness profiles 并实现 P1–P20-0029-2026-07-17T08:25:53.112427+00:00
runs.task_id: 14. 建立同源 PBT smoke/correctness profiles 并实现 P1–P20
runs.notes: C17 Verification / Task 14 re-verify on TRUE WHOLE FOLDER (not a cherry-picked file subset like seq-25): HYPOTHESIS_PROFILE=correctness python -m pytest tests/procedure_delegation_visibility/ -> 376 passed / 0 failed / 0 error / 0 skipped in ~263s on PostgreSQL audit_platform. This closes the whole-folder-only test-interference gap: whole-folder collection interleaves the V113 schema-contract DDL (DROP/CREATE TABLE + triggers on the 4 V113 tables, AccessExclusiveLock) with the delegation/gap PBT INSERTs (RowExclusive on the same tables + FK parents) on the shared dev DB; the 4 DB-heavy PBT classes could deadlock ONLY under whole-folder (green in isolation/pairwise). Root-cause fix lives in test/support code and is load-bearing: test_v113_schema_contract.py::_exec_ddl_with_retry sets SET LOCAL lock_timeout=800ms (< 1000ms deadlock_timeout) so DDL yields with LockNotAvailable BEFORE a cycle forms + jittered retry; _factories.py::run_isolated re-runs the whole (idempotent, fully-rolled-back) example on transient lock SQLSTATEs (40P01/55P03/40001) with backoff. No assertion loosened, no skip, no lowered example count (each gap property still 100 valid examples at correctness). Pinned artifacts are DETERMINISTIC and byte-reproducible by the CI whole-folder correctness command (NOT the timing-laden raw junit, which is what drifted seq-24): (1) task14_whole_folder_correctness_summary.json = timing/timestamp/hostname-stripped, sorted testcase outcomes + totals (376/376 passed); (2) valid_example_counts.correctness.frozen.json = deterministic write_report snapshot (P9/P10/P12/P15/P16/P18/P19/P20 + same_source_demo = 100 each), reproduced byte-identically by this whole-folder run (sha 44d3129a...). Raw evidence also on disk (not hash-pinned to avoid timing drift): task14_whole_folder_correctness_junit.xml + task14_whole_folder_hypothesis_statistics.txt. Append-only: seq-24 (task14_full_correctness_junit.xml / _hypothesis_statistics.txt volatile generic names) remains and its recomputed hashes no longer match after later reruns overwrote those generic-named files; it is a superseded historical run and cannot be removed. Task 18 Completion Guard uses latest-run-per-task, so this run supersedes seq-24/seq-25 for Task 14.
